### Summary Table

| Feature | Vector ($v^i$) | Covector ($\omega_i$) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Definition | Element of vector space $V$ | Element of dual space $V^*$ (Linear functional) |
| Analogy | An arrow, a displacement, a velocity | A gradient, a density, a "measuring stick" |
| Action | It is the input to a covector | It is the operator that acts on a vector |
| In GR | Represents things like "velocity" | Represents things like "momentum" or "gradients" |
| Transformation | Transforms like a vector under coordinate change | Transforms like a covector (it "absorbs" the Jacobian) |
